text:
Elena (CSM): Heads-up — MediAtlas returned the vendor security questionnaire. They flagged KMS (they want BYOK), need a dataflow/network diagram for SOC2 evidence, and clarity on embeddings retention. Can we triage?
Ben (Security): Ack. Can someone paste their questionnaire link? I want to grep for exact wording on BYOK + subprocessors.
Elena (CSM): Link: https://files.mediatlas.co/vend-qa-2026.pdf — questions on p3 (KMS) and p7 (data residency).
Jin (Legal): Noted. Also they attached a standard DPA redline asking for a 3rd-party subprocessors list. We need to supply subprocessors + SOC2 scope statement.
Ravi (Eng): I can produce a data flow diagram and an environment list (prod/staging/nonprod). Do they want network CIDRs or just logical diagram?
Elena (CSM): They asked for both if possible, but legal said logical + list of endpoints should be sufficient for now.
Ben (Security): For KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations. Key differences to call out: key provenance (BYOK), key rotation control, and if they require HSM-backed attestation. Quick snippet we can give them:
```
kms:
  provider: aws:kms
  key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE
  mode: BYOK
```
Ben (Security): Also note: BYOK availability depends on Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted. I'll add a short explainer paragraph.
Marta (Product): Quick product feedback: several customers say the vendor questionnaire is too long and duplicative. Would it help if we provided a "concise answers pack" that maps our short answers to common questionnaire questions? I can draft a template.
Elena (CSM): Yes — that'd be huge. MediAtlas is time-pressed and flagged the length as a blocker for onboarding. If Marta can make the pack, we can attach it to the DPA response.
Jin (Legal): Please include a standard clause referencing our SOC2 scope (Controls in place for data handling) and a subprocessor list link. Legal will sign off on the template before sending.
Ravi (Eng): One engineering caveat: for non-prod we use ephemeral keys and masking for PII in dev datasets. I'll add that to the diagram/notes. Also recommend we explicitly call out that embeddings are stored encrypted at rest for X days by default (specify actual TTL).
Elena (CSM): Action items: 
- Ravi: produce dataflow + env list (by EOD tomorrow)
- Ben: draft KMS BYOK explainer + attestation options (tomorrow)
- Marta: create concise answers pack + template (48h)
- Jin: prepare subprocessors list + DPA redline guidance (48h)
I'll schedule an enablement sync with MediAtlas for Tue 10am PST — please tentatively hold that slot.
onboarding-bot: A ticket has been created: CS-4821 MediAtlas DPA/Questionnaire intake — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821. Assignees: Elena, Ben, Ravi, Marta, Jin.
Elena (CSM): One more thing — MediAtlas gave feedback that some questions are ambiguous about "access to raw logs". Can we add a one-line clarification in the pack: "Raw request logs are accessible to authorized ops for X days; sensitive fields are redacted."
Ben (Security): Agreed. I'll draft that line.
Marta (Product): Will iterate on the template using that sentence. Also opening a product doc ticket to discuss splitting the questionnaire into "required" vs "optional" sections; will share a draft by EOD Friday.
Elena (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update the customer and share the ticket link. Please post any files into the Jira ticket so we have a single source.
